palette: porcelain slate cabinet, docket bone cards, exclusion vermilion, correction ochre, defect cobalt, admissibility pine, graphite ink
typography: WenKai grading-plate headings with specimen codes, verdict hang-tags and thin condition rules
composition: one intake rail dropping into three graded shafts, each ending in a hanging verdict tag, with a correction bench branching off the minor-defect shaft
surface: porcelain grading cabinet with paper evidence cards, recessed track channels and hanging verdict tags
motion: specimen cards ride the intake rail, receive a grade stamp at the reading mouth, drop through shafts and settle as verdict hang-tags; the correction bench turns one defective card back into the admissible tray
transition: the cabinet frame and intake rail persist while shaft groups are replaced
